cards.title: Should we move closer to family before school?
cards.body: A parent weighs relocating near family support versus staying put and building new friendships. The decision involves weighing financial costs and emotional trade-offs as your child starts school.

cards.title: My son's back home – mothering skills tested
cards.body: A mother navigates having her adult son return home post-graduation. She humorously reflects on the adjustment from empty nest back to active parenting.

cards.title: Should parents leave kids to pursue adventures?
cards.body: An essay examines whether it's acceptable for parents with small children to abandon family for wilderness survival or world travel. The question challenges societal expectations around parental presence.

cards.title: Help your child navigate emotions when overwhelmed
cards.body: Parents can teach emotional regulation by modeling healthy responses to stress. The Seven Shifts framework helps both adults and children solve emotional problems together.

cards.title: End homework battles with simple strategies
cards.body: Learn practical techniques to help children get started on schoolwork and stay organized. Empower kids to take ownership of their academic responsibilities.

cards.title: Understanding psychopathic mothers' impact on children
cards.body: Psychopathic mothers emotionally and psychologically abuse children through lovelessness and calculated division. Understanding this dynamic helps adult children recognize harmful patterns.

cards.title: Phones banned from pupils' bags or pockets
cards.body: The UK government strengthens school guidance restricting phone access in pupils' possessions. This stricter policy aims to improve focus and reduce classroom distractions.

cards.title: Tories pledge to cut benefits for children with ADHD
cards.body: Conservative shadow minister Helen Whately criticizes current benefit systems for children with milder ADHD cases. She warns against putting children on a 'conveyor belt' toward lifetime benefits.
